brief.title: Hollowmere
brief.premise: A surveyor arrives in a mist-bound village where no one will say what happens to those who leave before dawn, and learns that the village's lanterns are keeping something out.
constraints: Do not explain the entity in the mist; its nature must stay unknown.

world.name: Hollowmere
world.description: Hollowmere is a mist-bound village of lantern posts and silent rules, where the night belongs to something no one will name.

locations.name: Lantern Green
locations.description: The village common, ringed by iron lantern posts lit from dusk to dawn.

locations.name: Chapel Ruin
locations.description: A roofless chapel at the village edge where the mist is always thickest.

locations.name: Ferry Stair
locations.description: A stone stair down to the mere, where the only road out begins.

factions.name: Lamp Wardens
factions.description: Villagers who tend the lantern posts and keep a nightly vigil.

factions.name: Chapel Remnant
factions.description: A few elders who still hold services in the Chapel Ruin and say the mist is a judgment.

rules.statement: The lanterns on Lantern Green must burn from dusk to dawn, and the mist does not cross lit ground.
No one may leave Hollowmere before dawn; those who do are not seen again.
Villagers never speak of what lives in the mist.
The ferry crosses the mere only in daylight.

history.name: The Lighting of the Posts
history.description: After the first night of mist, the villagers raised iron posts and kept them burning, and the mist stopped at the lit ground, because the thing in it is a drowned ferryman's hunger.

history.name: The Fall of the Chapel
history.description: The chapel roof collapsed during a night when every lantern burned bright, yet the mist poured across the lit ground and took the cellar.

history.name: The Missing Surveyor
history.description: A surveyor walked down Ferry Stair before dawn, was seen again the next evening, and told the Lamp Wardens what he had found in the mist.

conflicts.name: The Vigil Dispute
conflicts.description: The Chapel Remnant says the lanterns defy judgment, while the Lamp Wardens say the vigil is the only thing keeping them alive.

evidence_quotes: the thing in it is a drowned ferryman's hunger
labels.correction_hint: Remove the explanation of the entity.

evidence_quotes: the mist poured across the lit ground
the mist does not cross lit ground
labels.rationale: The mist crosses lit ground while every lantern burns.
labels.correction_hint: Make the lanterns gutter before the mist enters.

evidence_quotes: was seen again the next evening
those who do are not seen again
labels.rationale: A pre-dawn leaver returns, contradicting the dawn rule.

evidence_summary: Three defects: the entity is explained (brief forbids), the mist crosses lit ground (rule forbids), and a pre-dawn leaver is seen again (rule forbids).
